theorems.name: Submission.cbr_cipi_affine_plane_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → Euclid P) (a : Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ w → Measure.map (fun z : Fin m → ℝ => a + ∑ i, z i • w i) volume = (μHE[m] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - a ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w)} ∧ IsClosed {y : Euclid P | y - a ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w)} ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ((μHE[m] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - a ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w)}) K < ∞) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → 0 < ((μHE[m] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - a ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w)}) (ball a r)
